title: Cluster size distributions of discrete random fields
summary: We study size distributions of finite excursion clusters of discrete random fields on the integer lattice $\mathbb Z^d$. For stationary fields, we assign a unique root to each finite cluster and derive an exact representation of the root Palm size law through joint exceedance and exterior nonexceedance probabilities for complete connected shapes. Root sampling gives each finite cluster equal weight and remains well defined even when infinite components are present.
